summary: Software Engineer with 3 years of experience engineering scalable backend ecosystems, full-stack applications and intelligent AI integrations. Expert in building event-driven microservices (.NET Core, Node.js) and managing distributed data layers across SQL and NoSQL environments. Adept at handling live production monitoring, cross-border team collaboration, and cloud-native containerization with Docker.

highlights: Co-own the development and maintenance of event-driven backend microservices for XplorPay, a critical US-based payment system processing billions of dollars in transactions regularly.

Led the technical implementation for the biannual Card Association Updates (Visa, MasterCard, Discover, Amex), designing complex feature changes that secured 100% compliance across two consecutive release cycles.
Serve on the active on-call rotation, monitoring live production data, troubleshooting high-priority runtime bugs, and ensuring platform reliability and data integrity.
Partner and communicate daily with US-based product and engineering teams to align on feature requirements, bug fixes, and system architecture updates.
Sole backend developer for TaxEve, independently designing and implementing the entire backend for an e-filing platform supporting 1099 forms.
Delivered the complete MVP within four months, handling authentication, payments (Stripe), business logic, and secure API development.
Managed system integrations and AWS deployment, focusing heavily on backend performance, robustness, and security.
Enhanced backend functionality for the Farvision 4.5 ERP, developing and maintaining server-side components for real estate application workflows.
Supported database management, API integration, and backend business logic using .NET, C#, and MS SQL.

projects.title: eCommerceSolution
projects.subtitle: Distributed Microservices System
highlights: Engineered a decoupled microservices ecosystem (User, Product, Order, Inventory) from scratch using .NET Core and Ocelot, with RabbitMQ (Mass Transit) for asynchronous messaging.

Engineered a natural language product search integrating Qdrant Vector Database and local LLMs (via Semantic Kernel); implemented a two-step hybrid search combining exact MS SQL pre-filtering with vector semantic matching.

Built an email microservice using Microsoft Semantic Kernel and a local LLM (via LM Studio) to write personalized order confirmations using native Kernel Functions to dynamically query real-time product data.

Deployed a multi-database system utilizing PostgreSQL for identity, MS SQL Server for transactional catalogs, and MongoDB for orders; integrated Redis distributed cache to offload high-frequency reads.
Containerized the system using Docker Compose, establishing isolated virtual networks to shield databases from the public internet while preserving secure inter-service API communication.

projects.title: WeaveWhisper
projects.subtitle: Multi-Vendor E-Commerce Marketplace
highlights: Developed a responsive multi-vendor e-commerce platform bridging independent clothing brands with customers using React and Java Spring Boot.
Implemented secure, custom authentication pipelines via Spring Security & JWT to decouple workflows for Customer accounts and Brand admin dashboards.
Integrated AWS S3 for multipart high-res media uploads and engineered secure transactional checkouts via Razorpay API webhooks.
Built dynamic, multi-attribute product filtering (brand, size, price) using Redux Toolkit for efficient client-side state synchronization.
